description:
Saet-Byeol, a sharp-tongued Omega hiding his secondary gender, has no intention of ever finding a mate. But everything changes when he discovers that his classmate Yul, an emotional Alpha with a fate complex, is his destined pair. The catch? Yul believes Saet-Byeol is a Beta and mistakes his feelings for simple friendship. Determined to ignore his growing attraction, Saet-Byeol keeps his distance. When Jae-Young, an openly dominant Omega, transfers into their class and immediately captures Yul’s attention, Saet-Byeol finds it harder and harder to keep his own heart frozen.

A cold-blooded secret, a one-sided fate, and a love triangle that defies logic. How long can they keep their true desires buried before everything starts to melt?

(Source: Lezhin US)
